hypothesis: The 5e-5 learning rate transferred from the earlier recipe is not necessarily optimal for one-epoch, rank-128 Qwen3.5-4B soft distillation on monitoring-only trajectories.
intervention: Train AdamW at learning rates 1e-5, 2e-5, 5e-5, 1e-4, and 2e-4 with one seed; all other training fields remain fixed.
baseline: A freshly trained monitoring-only AdamW 5e-5 cell under the same fast-kernel and batch recipe.

training.objective: Kimi K3 binary soft-target BCE at selected literal 0/1 logits

required_kernels.FLA_DISABLE_BACKEND_DISPATCH: 1 (use the default Triton kernels; bypass the failing optional TileLang dispatcher)

selection.dataset: the frozen 3,012-row held-out ID development suite
selection.replacement_gate: Require at least +0.005 macro pAUROC@20 over the retrained 5e-5 control, no source pAUROC@20 regression worse than 0.01, and no macro Brier regression worse than 0.005.
selection.promotion_scope: one-seed pruning only; confirm the selected recipe across seeds before final OOD evaluation

stop_conditions: Training or ID-development input identity, provenance, row count, or checksum drifts.
Any deception row enters training or an arm other than Kimi-soft-only AdamW is introduced.
The rank-128, microbatch-2 longest-sequence preflight OOMs.
FLA 0.5.2, causal-conv1d 1.6.2.post1, or isolated Triton 3.7.1 is unavailable or unbound after model import, or the recorded FLA backend is not the frozen default Triton path.
Quantization, effective batch, epoch count, scheduler, warmup, weight decay, prompt, or selected-token objective differs across cells.
Any causal master, serving rebase, parity report, ID score, or row is missing, duplicated, truncated, non-finite, or inconsistent.
The strict OOD suite is consulted before the one-seed selection is frozen.
